how-to-startup
==========
This how to describes how the trailer is setup on a new location


Check Energy
-------------
 1. Check fuel level
 2. Check generator, is it on autostart?
 3. Batteries full?
 4. TBS on?

Start Picarro
-------------
See startup sequence at wiki:devices/picarro. Starting the picarro takes approx. 1h.

Make the mobile internet connection
---------------------
Just start, you will need to enter the trailer password twice:

    gsm start

The script is defined in trailer/tools. Then kill the firewall to allow access from the other VPN-clients (eg. your computer):

    sudo iptables -F

Start the Servers
-------------
Connect from the picarro screen to the IPC using Putty.

The trailer servers should run in the background. We are using the relative simple solution screen. 
There is a helper to run those servers in a screen, called run.

 1. go to the trailer directory `cd trailer`
 2. Start all 3 servers (wiki, logger, sampler) with `run_all`

If you see strange error messages from python in the logbook, switch to the sampler terminal to 
investigate:   

    show sampler

You can use the `show` command also for the other servers to the terminal (logger, wiki). You leave it with
ctrl+a+d
